newsitem.title: UK: Freegold, Harmony in sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Freegold, Harmony in sale talks.

text.p: Free State Consolidated Gold Mines Ltd (Freegold) and Harmony Gold Mining Company Ltd (Harmony) said on Monday they were in talks about the possible sale of Freegold's Free State Saaiplaas No. 3 shaft to Harmony.
In a joint statement released in London, the South African companies said Harmony's management would conduct a due diligence exercise lasting around six weeks. Talks would resume after that period.
The companies said workers at No. 3 shaft would be re-employed at Freegold's Saaiplaas No. 5 shaft and elsewhere in Freegold group if the sale went ahead.
